lock.desc: Exit: a trigger name (e.g. exit:open). The exit stays shut, whatever happens to the boxes, until something sends it (an onDie or onPickup $trigger).

healRange.desc: Repair drone: how far (px) its repair beam reaches. Every healRate frames it repairs the most damaged robot in sight within this range.

healAmount.desc: Repair drone: health given back per repair, never above the robot's starting health.

followRange.desc: Repair drone: with nothing to repair, it stays near the nearest robot in sight within this range (px).

beamColor.desc: Repair drone: the repair beam's colour (0xRRGGBB).

chaser.desc: While attacking, drive toward the player until within chaseDistance. After losing sight, drive to where it last saw them.

strafer.desc: While attacking and facing its target, slide side to side across the player's line of fire (strafeAccel, strafeRate).

wanderer.desc: When idle, cast wanderSamples random rays and drive toward the farthest wall hit. Needs no path nodes. With hunter: travel between random path nodes instead.

patroller.desc: Walk a chain of path nodes from its path group: round in a loop if the last node links back to the first, otherwise back and forth. Turns hunter and wanderer off. Needs path nodes.

hunter.desc: Plan routes over the path nodes (A*). When an alerter spots the player, every hunter paths to the player. Re-plans when it bumps a wall. Needs path nodes.

alerter.desc: The first time it sees the player, send playerDetected so every hunter on the level comes for them. Default: on for hunters and patrollers.

suicidal.desc: Blow up near the player (suicideDistance) or after suicideTimeLimit frames of attacking, hitting a chased player for suicideDamage. Pair with chaser.

pathID.desc: Path group (node colour) used by hunter and patroller. "auto" = the group of the nearest path node it can see when it spawns.

patrolDirection.desc: Patrol direction along the chain: 1 forward, -1 backward.

chaseDistance.desc: How close a chaser gets to the player (px).

strafeRate.desc: Strafe speed (how fast it swings side to side).

moveMinDistance.desc: How close it gets to a waypoint before it counts as reached (px).

suicideDistance.desc: Distance to the player that sets off a suicidal enemy (px).

suicideTimeLimit.desc: Frames of attacking before a suicidal enemy blows up (31 frames = 1 s).

suicideDamage.desc: Damage a suicidal enemy does to the player it was chasing.

turnSpeed.desc: Turn speed of the body or turret (degrees per frame).

fixed.desc: Not knocked back or spun by hits, and keeps its rotation when it dies.

speedMin.desc: Below this speed it counts as stopped.

speed.desc: Push given to the player at the entrance.

mortarRange.desc: Mortar: farthest the player can be for it to fire (px). It needs no line of sight and lobs over walls.

mortarMinRange.desc: Mortar: closest the player can be for it to fire (px). Inside this the player is safe from its shells.

mortarLead.desc: Mortar: how far ahead of a moving player it aims, as a fraction of the shell's flight time (0 = where the player is now).

mortarSpread.desc: Mortar: random scatter of the landing point (px).

mortarFlightSpeed.desc: Mortar: shell speed along the ground (px per frame); slower gives the player more time to leave the landing ring.

visionRange.desc: Max distance it can see the player (px). Empty = unlimited.

autoVision.desc: Ignore vision zones and make its own zone from 90 rays when the level starts.

resistence.desc: Knockback and stun resistance (higher = pushed less).

radius.desc: Collision radius (px). Default: half its width.

required.desc: Must be destroyed to open the exit.

deathRoll.desc: Tumble across the floor before exploding.

blastMark.desc: Scorch mark clip left on the floor.

frag.desc: Shrapnel clip thrown when it dies.

particleType.desc: Particle clip for its death burst.

powerupDrop.desc: Pickup dropped when it dies, e.g. {"type": "primary", "item": "Plasma", "quantity": 10, "probability": 0.5}.

onDie.desc: Runs when it dies; {"$trigger": "door2:open"} sends triggers.

spawnTrigger.desc: Stay hidden and inactive until this trigger is sent, then warp in.

item.desc: Weapon name (primary/secondary), health kind (health, superHealth, healthMax), trigger name(s) for a trigger pad, or keycard (yellowKey, blueKey, redKey, greenKey, purpleKey, aquaKey) for a key or lock.

unlock.desc: Lock pads: the trigger sent once the keycard is used, e.g. door1:open.

persistent.desc: Stays after it's picked up (and can fire again).

onPickup.desc: Runs when picked up; {"$trigger": "door2:open"} sends triggers.

alertMessage.desc: Message shown while the player is over it.

alertOnce.desc: Show the message only the first time in the level. Put it on every copy of a new weapon (pickups and drops) with the same intro message.

alertLinger.desc: Seconds the message stays up after the player leaves (default 4).

alertKillTrigger.desc: Trigger that removes the message (instead of leaving the area).

id.desc: Door id; it listens for <id>:open and <id>:close.

connections.desc: Pinned links to other nodes (edit with Path links).
